term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (audiovisual works: 50 years from making or first public availability; anonymous and pseudonymous works: 50 years from first release)
moral_rights: Paternity & integrity (same term as economic rights)
digital_protection: Anti-circumvention, TPM & rights-management info rules (Part VI, ss. 37-39)
fair_use_exceptions: Part IV: s.16 private copy, quotation, s.19 teaching/research, s.20 libraries/archives, s.23 visually impaired/print-disabled
enforcement_body: Ministry of Arts and Culture (with the Attorney General's Office)
